stories.headline: Ceasefire talks resume after overnight strikes
stories.summary: Negotiators resumed talks after renewed strikes near the border.
stories.whyItMatters: The exchange could weaken the current ceasefire framework.

stories.headline: Malaria pilot reports fewer severe cases
stories.summary: A regional pilot reported fewer severe cases after expanded prevention work.
stories.whyItMatters: The results may guide future public-health funding if they hold up in wider review.
